newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to open tender to privatise tyre firm.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to open tender to privatise tyre firm.

text.p: Turkey's privatisation agency OIB will open a tender on Monday for the block sale of a 99.96 percent state stake in tyre producer Petlas Lastik Sanayi A.S. which could not be privatised in four previous tenders since late 1993, the OIB said in a statement.
It said the deadline for bids would be November 4 in the tender which will be completed after negotiations with the bidders.

No bids were received in Petlas's block sale tenders held in October 1993, July and November 1995. The state stake was sold to local Nadir impex company in the April 1994 tender, but the sale was cancelled in April 1995 on grounds that the buyer did not meet its obligations.

The OIB, which will require a 15 billion lira letter of guarantee from the bidders in the new tender, said it could also demand an extra collateral of up to five percent of the highest bid at any stage in the tender.

Petlas which posted a one-trillion-lira loss in 1995, has about a five percent share in the domestic tyre market and is the sole producer of aircraft tyres in Turkey. Its first half loss this year was 490 billion lira.
Petlas produced 447,000 motor vehicle tyres and 2,428 aircraft tyres in January-August this year, earning 1.7 trillion lira sales revenue.
